title: Unknown sender to the King (Francis I), BnF fr. 3029 ff. 134-135, no. 59 (DECODE R3670)

documents.shelfmark: BnF, Français 3029, ff. 134r-135v, no. 59 (DECODE R3670); Gallica btv1b90598719 views 210, 211, 213
documents.route: unknown -> French court (addressed 'Au Roy, Mon souverain seigneur')

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaves. Lasry's key table (05/11/2023) for this cipher is on Tomokiyo's cryptiana GL.htm, which lists f.134 among the letters in the cipher but prints readable text only for f.67 and f.186.

transcription.source: Gallica full-resolution views 210 (f.134r, 26 lines) and 211 (f.135r, 4 lines); line-band crops; aliases = key letters in transcription.txt
transcription.notes: 926 letter signs (measured on signs.txt, now withheld); plus 49 nulls and 9 name/place signs: 984 signs in all.

system.summary: Simple substitution with invented signs (one per letter, O with two forms), words spaced, six null signs and five name/place signs (Lasry key).
system.notes: Lasry's table has Nom 1-4 and Place 1 unidentified; all five occur here and stay unidentified.

prior_solution.where: Lasry key table (05/11/2023) on Tomokiyo's cryptiana GL.htm (section 'De la Tremoille's(?) Cipher'); no plaintext of f.134 published there or on DECODE

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the problem with /goal (the DECODE R3670 catalogue card). No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Repo grep: fr3029/ (catalogue 174) had closed the fr. 3029 ciphers as 'broken by Lasry' without reading any leaf; Tomokiyo's GL.htm lists f.134 under the fr. 3029 cipher; key image fetched.
Gallica SRU dc.source 'Français 3029' gave btv1b90598719; canvases unlabelled, so contact strips (views 182-218) located f.134r = view 210, f.135r = 211, address = 213.
30 cipher lines transcribed by eye from line-band crops, each sign written as its key letter (transcription withheld).
Lasry's table applied unchanged: French reads at once.
Blotted and doubtful signs re-cropped at full resolution; one blot resolved.
lang.lm.best_language on the letters: fr-1600-letters first (-2.00 vs fr-modern -2.20, la -2.69).

outcome.notes: All 30 cipher lines read with Lasry's key unchanged; 9 name/place signs open. Withheld 22 Sept 2026 at George Lasry's request: he and a historian have deciphered and analysed these letters for their own publication. Readings, transcriptions and content are kept outside the public repository; counts and method fields stand as measured.

gaps.item: name signs N1-N4 and place sign P1 (9 tokens)

outcome.fraction_read_source: signs.txt (withheld): 984 signs, 9 name/place signs without a value = 975/984
